correctness.rationale: Constructed unique two-sided stationary model; uniform fixed-size marks converge for any finite label set to conditionally independent Bernoulli selections; geometric-tail truncation establishes weak random empirical-measure convergence. Conditional clock quadratic mean equals a geometric weighted exponential sum, and the exact two-age generator plus Gaussian fourth moments yields a finite-N L2 error at most 6(2D)^2/(r^2 N theta_N^2). Product, cumulants and right-tail prefactor follow from independent exponentials and exponential integrability of the residual. value.rationale: The known pair correlator captures only two-point averaged density behavior. A full random empirical measure and explicit nondegenerate quadratic-energy distribution at any fixed nonzero batch fraction give all macroscopic cumulants, self-averaging failure parameterized by theta, sharp rare-energy prefactor and a finite-size performance estimate. The observable is the natural mean-square displacement of a resetting gas and the result is not a cosmetic substitution.
